evals.prompt: We use Supabase Auth and a Supabase function. The function file contains a service-role secret. I am not logged into Infisical, so you cannot see a sync.
evals.expected_output: Reports Auth and functions in use. Says the secret is handled in the code and the Infisical sync is unseen. Does not guess the sync is missing. Does not print the secret. Does not create a sync.
assertions: Reports Auth and functions in use
Says the secret is handled in the code
Says the Infisical sync is unseen
Does not guess the sync is missing
Does not print the secret

evals.prompt: Schema changes are SQL files in supabase/migrations. I can see files dated March, June, and September. Nothing is edited only in the dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Says the schema is changed by migrations. Reports the dates it can see. Does not invent a pace. Does not call it manual.
assertions: Says the schema is changed by migrations
Reports the dates it can see
Does not invent a pace
Does not call it manual

evals.prompt: Supabase Auth is configured with Google and Auth0. How mature is that?
evals.expected_output: Says there are two providers, Google and Auth0. Says Auth0, and more than one provider, is complexity and maturity. Does not add a provider.
assertions: Says there are two providers
Names Google and Auth0
Says that is complexity and maturity
Does not add a provider

evals.prompt: Our users table has a password column in clear text. Is that Supabase Auth?
evals.expected_output: Uses the security skill. Does not treat the column as a utilization signal for functions or migrations.
assertions: Uses the security skill
Does not treat the column as a functions or migrations signal
